_comment: Lier's first line: 'Spells can't be countered.' A claim about EVERY spell every player casts, which the card-level `uncounterable` flag cannot make -- that one is a card saying it about itself. Reuses the pool's existing t_counterspell rather than defining a second one. t_lier also carries the granted-flashback half; t_lier_no_exile is a plain metered permission -- the spell goes BACK to the graveyard -- which is what makes the exile rider visible.
